headline: Gold steady today, silver near its lowest in the 33-day history shown
summary: 24k gold is ₹12,481 per gram, up just ₹1 (0.01%) from yesterday, so today's move is effectively flat. Over the last seven days gold has eased about 0.6%, and across the 33 days shown it is down about 12.6% from ₹14,275 on 26 October. Silver at ₹1,64,900 per kg is down ₹100 today, roughly flat, but about 5.8% lower over seven days and about 25% below its ₹2,20,000 level on 26 October. Spot prices were unchanged since today's rate was set, so the drift looks like a lagging move in international prices plus the rupee at about ₹92.5 per dollar; festive and wedding demand and import duty are other possible factors.
outlook: Prices are flat today after a sustained fall, so there is no urgency either way; if you are buying for a jewellery or coin purchase, compare making charges and GST across shops before deciding.
